traits.name: Painsight
traits.text: (divination, divine); A velstrac automatically knows whether a creature it sees has any of the doomed, dying, and wounded conditions, as well as the value of those conditions.

traits.name: Ignore Pain
traits.text: An eremite's actions can't be disrupted due to damage or Strikes (such as Attack of Opportunity).

traits.name: Paralytic Perfection
traits.text: (aura, divine, enchantment, fear, incapacitation, mental, visual); 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it feels compelled to offer pieces of its own flesh to the eremite. The creature must succeed at a DC 40 Will save or become paralyzed for 1 round.

traits.name: Evisceration
traits.text: ⬻ (attack); Requirements The eremite has a creature grabbed Effect The eremite excises flesh or bone from a creature it has grabbed. The target takes 6d10 (6d10) persistent bleed damage.

traits.name: Exquisite Pain
traits.text: An eremite's knowledge of pressure points and pain centers is unsurpassed. A creature hit by an eremite's melee Strikes must succeed at a DC 40 Fortitude save or be stunned 2 (stunned 4 on a critical failure). A creature that critically succeeds is temporarily immune for 24 hours.

traits.name: Focus Gaze
traits.text: ⬻ (concentrate, divine, enchantment, fear, mental, visual); The eremite stares at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The creature must immediately attempt a Will save against paralytic perfection. In addition, if the creature was already paralyzed, on a failed save, its unnatural longing causes it to become doomed 1. After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the eremite's next turn.

traits.name: Graft Flesh
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The eremite holds a piece of flesh they collected via Evisceration Effect The eremite attaches the stolen flesh to themself. They either regain 100 Hit Points; reduce the value of their clumsy, drained, enfeebled, or stupefied condition by 3; or reduce the stage of any affliction affecting them by 3.

traits.name: Shadow Traveler
traits.text: (divine, divination); When an eremite uses plane shift or shadow walk, they arrive at exactly their intended destination.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +39 (evil, magical); Damage 4d8+19 (4d8+19) piercing plus 2d6 (2d6) persistent bleed and exquisite pain

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +39 (agile, evil, magical); Damage 3d6+19 (3d6+19) slashing plus 2d6 (2d6) persistent bleed, exquisite pain, and Improved Grab
